title: A file-system failure while recording a registration outcome names the wrong cause in the launcher summary
outcome: When saving the run's records fails around registration (request.json after a durable registration, or the failure result after a refusal), the launcher's summary names that write failure as the cause, not a refused registration or a launch stopped while registering.
acceptance: A file-system failure while recording a registration outcome names the wrong cause in the launcher summary is done
